entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... um, I think I need to make a return? I'm just a bit lost with this whole process.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can certainly help you with that. Could I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, it's Maria Garcia. The order number is... VF78-99-B42.

Thank you, Maria. I'm pulling that up now... I see you purchased the VeloBand GPS Tracker. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, preference, I guess? I just feel so overwhelmed by it. The website made it look simple, but I can't figure it out and I don't think I'll ever use it. Can't you just help me? I just want to send it back.

I understand it can be a lot to take in with a new device. Let me check the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered 22 days ago. I do need to let you know that our return **policy** for wearable electronics can be quite strict. For sanitation reasons, especially with products that have skin contact, there are firm deadlines.
Deadlines? Oh no. Does that mean... am I too late?

Well, for some of our newer items, after 20 days it would be **too late** to process a return due to our **hygiene** protocols. We have to be very careful about that. But let me just confirm the specific policy for your VeloBand GPS Tracker model... one moment please.

Alright, I have good news for you, Maria. Your specific model falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you're only at 22 days, you are well within the window to send it back for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried. Thank you! So what do I do now?

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account right now. All you need to do is package the VeloBand in its original box, affix the label, and drop it at a post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
